detail.readme:
# Hi.Events ### Open-source event ticketing and management platform Sell tickets online for conferences, nightlife events, concerts, club nights, workshops, and festivals.
Self-hosted or cloud. Your events, your brand, your data. [Try Cloud →](https://app.hi.events/auth/register?utm_source=gh-readme) · [Live Demo](https://app.hi.events/event/2/hievents-conference-2030?utm_source=gh-readme) · [Documentation](https://hi.events/docs?utm_source=gh-readme) · [Enterprise & licensing](https://hi.events/licensing?utm_source=gh-readme) · [Website](https://hi.events?utm_source=gh-readme) [![License: AGPL v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-AGPL_v3-blue.svg)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/blob/develop/LICENCE) [![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/HiEventsDev/hi.events?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/releases) [![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/HiEventsDev/hi.events?style=flat)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events) [![Docker Pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/daveearley/hi.events-all-in-one)](https://hub.docker.com/r/daveearley/hi.events-all-in-one) [![E2E Tests](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/actions/workflows/e2e.yml/badge.svg?event=push)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/actions/workflows/e2e.yml)

English · Deutsch · Français · Italiano · Nederlands · Español · Português · Português (Brasil) · Polski · Čeština · Slovenčina · Magyar · Svenska · Suomi · Ελληνικά · Türkçe · Tiếng Việt · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어


> [!NOTE] > **Hi.Events 2.0 is here** with recurring events, reserved seating, a box office, lineups and schedules, single > sign-on, team permissions and API keys. [See what's new →](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/releases)

## Why Hi.Events? Most ticketing platforms take a fee on every ticket and keep your customer data. **Hi.Events is an open-source alternative to Eventbrite, Tickettailor, Dice.fm and other ticketing platforms** that gives you full control over your branding, checkout and data. Trusted by thousands of event organizers worldwide — from nightlife promoters and festivals to venues, community groups, and conference hosts. Run it yourself, or let us run it for you on Hi.Events Cloud.
## Features **📅 Events** - One-off and recurring events, with per-date prices, capacity and times - Duplicate an event in one click - Saved venues and online events - Event homepage designer and branded organizer pages - Lineup and schedule pages **🎟️ Tickets & products** - Paid, free, donation and tiered tickets - Reserved seating Enterprise - Add-ons and merchandise - Hidden tickets unlocked by promo codes - Per-order limits and scheduled sale windows - Shared capacity and automatic waitlists **🛒 Selling** - Customisable embeds for your own site: ticket widgets, buttons, event lists, lineups and schedules - Promo codes and discounts - Tracking links for promoters and affiliates - Custom registration questions - Marketing opt-in at checkout - Meta, TikTok, Google Analytics and Tag Manager tracking **💳 Payments** - Payouts to your own Stripe account - Taxes and fees, included or added at checkout - Invoicing and offline payments - Full and partial refunds **🚪 Attendees & the door** - Box office for door sales Enterprise - Check-in by phone camera or USB scanner - Shareable check-in lists with live counts - Attendee messaging and custom email templates - Branded PDF tickets - Manually added attendees - Sales, tax and promo code reports
## Built for organisations **🔐 Security & access** - Single sign-on - Two-factor authentication - Team roles and permissions - Multiple organizers under one account **🔌 Integrations** - REST API and API keys - Webhooks - CSV and XLSX exports **🗄️ Your data** - Self-host with Docker - Account deletion and anonymisation - Available in 21 languages **✅ Tested** - A comprehensive test suite is run on every change
## Quick Start Built with **Laravel 13** (PHP >=8.3) · **React 19** with SSR · **TypeScript** · **PostgreSQL** · **Redis** · **Docker**. ### One-Click Deploy [![Deploy on DigitalOcean](https://www.deploytodo.com/do-btn-blue.svg)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events-digitalocean) [![Deploy to Render](https://render.com/images/deploy-to-render-button.svg)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events-render.com) [![Deploy on Railway](https://railway.com/button.svg)](https://railway.com/deploy/8CGKmu?referralCode=KvSr11) [![Deploy on Zeabur](https://zeabur.com/button.svg)](https://zeabur.com/templates/8DIRY6) ### Docker ```bash git clone https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events.git cd hi.events/docker/all-in-one cp .env.example .env # Generate keys (Linux/macOS) echo "APP_KEY=base64:$(openssl rand -base64 32)" >> .env echo "JWT_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 32)" >> .env docker compose up -d ``` > [!TIP] > **Windows users:** See `./docker/all-in-one/README.md` for key generation instructions. Open `http://localhost:8123` and create your account. 📖 [Full installation guide](https://hi.events/docs/getting-started?utm_source=gh-readme) > [!IMPORTANT] > **Upgrading from 1.x?** Read the [release notes](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/releases) before upgrading. ### REST API Create API keys under **Settings → API keys**, where you'll also find the API reference.
## Languages English, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Nederlands, Español, Português, Português (Brasil), Polski, Čeština, Slovenčina, Magyar, Svenska, Suomi, Ελληνικά, Türkçe, Tiếng Việt, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語 and 한국어. Corrections and new languages are welcome — see the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md).
## Hi.Events Cloud Prefer not to self-host? **[Hi.Events Cloud](https://app.hi.events/auth/register?utm_source=gh-readme)** is the fully managed version, run by the team that builds Hi.Events. [Get started →](https://app.hi.events/auth/register?utm_source=gh-readme)
## Licensing Hi.Events is licensed under **AGPL-3.0 with additional terms**. The additional terms require the "Powered by Hi.Events" attribution to be retained on pages and emails generated by the software — see [LICENCE](LICENCE) for the exact wording. Reserved seating and the box office are covered by the [Hi.Events Enterprise Licence](backend/ee/LICENCE) and need a licence for production use. **Commercial licences are available** if you'd like to remove the attribution or need terms that suit a white-labelled deployment. [Licensing options](https://hi.events/licensing?utm_source=gh-readme) · [hello@hi.events](mailto:hello@hi.events)
## Contributing Contributions are welcome — see the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started. Please open an issue or discussion before starting significant work so we can align on the approach. Contributors sign a [CLA](CLA.md).
## Security Found a vulnerability? Please report it privately to [security@hi.events](mailto:security@hi.events) rather than opening a public issue. See our [security policy](SECURITY.md).
## Support 📖 [Documentation](https://hi.events/docs?utm_source=gh-readme) · 🐛 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/issues) · 💬 [Discussions](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/discussions) · 📧 [hello@hi.events](mailto:hello@hi.events) New features and improvements are listed on the [releases page](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/releases).
**[Website](https://hi.events)** · **[Documentation](https://hi.events/docs)** · **[Cloud](https://app.hi.events/auth/register?utm_source=gh-readme)** · **[Licensing](https://hi.events/licensing)** Made with ☘️ in Ireland

自托管或云端部署。您的活动，您的品牌，您的数据。 [试用云端版 →](https://app.hi.events/auth/register?utm_source=gh-readme) · [在线演示](https://app.hi.events/event/2/hievents-conference-2030?utm_source=gh-readme) · [文档](https://hi.events/docs?utm_source=gh-readme) · [企业版与许可](https://hi.events/licensing?utm_source=gh-readme) · [官方网站](https://hi.events?utm_source=gh-readme) [![License: AGPL v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-AGPL_v3-blue.svg)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/blob/develop/LICENCE) [![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/HiEventsDev/hi.events?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/releases) [![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/HiEventsDev/hi.events?style=flat)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events) [![Docker Pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/daveearley/hi.events-all-in-one)](https://hub.docker.com/r/daveearley/hi.events-all-in-one) [![E2E Tests](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/actions/workflows/e2e.yml/badge.svg?event=push)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/actions/workflows/e2e.yml)

> [!NOTE] > **Hi.Events 2.0 正式发布**，新增周期性活动、座位预订、票房、阵容与日程、单点 > 登录、团队权限和 API 密钥。[查看新功能 →](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/releases)

## 为什么选择 Hi.Events？ 大多数售票平台按票抽成，还掌握着您的客户数据。**Hi.Events 是 Eventbrite、Tickettailor、Dice.fm 等售票平台的 开源替代方案**，让您完全掌控自己的 品牌、结账流程和数据。 全球数千家活动主办方的信赖之选——从夜生活推广方、音乐节，到场馆、社区团体 和会议主办方。您可以自行部署，也可以交给我们，在 Hi.Events Cloud 上为您托管。
## 功能特性 **📅 活动** - 单次活动与周期性活动，可按日期设置价格、容量和时间 - 一键复制活动 - 保存常用场馆，支持线上活动 - 活动主页设计器与品牌化主办方页面 - 阵容与日程页面 **🎟️ 门票与商品** - 付费票、免费票、捐赠票和阶梯票 - 座位预订 Enterprise - 附加项与周边商品 - 通过优惠码解锁的隐藏门票 - 单笔订单限购与定时开售 - 共享容量与自动候补名单 **🛒 销售** - 可嵌入自有网站的定制组件：售票挂件、按钮、活动列表、阵容和日程 - 优惠码与折扣 - 面向推广方和联盟伙伴的追踪链接 - 自定义报名问题 - 结账时征求营销订阅同意 - 支持 Meta、TikTok、Google Analytics 和 Tag Manager 追踪 **💳 支付** - 款项直接结算到您自己的 Stripe 账户 - 税费与手续费，可含在票价中或在结账时加收 - 发票与线下支付 - 全额与部分退款 **🚪 参会者与入场** - 现场售票的票房 Enterprise - 使用手机摄像头或 USB 扫码枪签到 - 可分享的签到名单，实时显示人数 - 参会者消息与自定义邮件模板 - 品牌化 PDF 门票 - 手动添加参会者 - 销售、税务和优惠码报表
## 专为机构打造 **🔐 安全与访问** - 单点登录 - 双重身份验证 - 团队角色与权限 - 一个账户管理多个主办方 **🔌 集成** - REST API 与 API 密钥 - Webhooks - CSV 和 XLSX 导出 **🗄️ 您的数据** - 使用 Docker 自托管 - 账户删除与匿名化 - 支持 21 种语言 **✅ 质量保障** - 每次变更都会运行全面的测试套件
## 快速开始 基于 **Laravel 13**（PHP >=8.3）· 支持 SSR 的 **React 19** · **TypeScript** · **PostgreSQL** · **Redis** · **Docker** 构建。 ### 一键部署 [![Deploy on DigitalOcean](https://www.deploytodo.com/do-btn-blue.svg)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events-digitalocean) [![Deploy to Render](https://render.com/images/deploy-to-render-button.svg)](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events-render.com) [![Deploy on Railway](https://railway.com/button.svg)](https://railway.com/deploy/8CGKmu?referralCode=KvSr11) [![Deploy on Zeabur](https://zeabur.com/button.svg)](https://zeabur.com/templates/8DIRY6) ### Docker ```bash git clone https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events.git cd hi.events/docker/all-in-one cp .env.example .env # Generate keys (Linux/macOS) echo "APP_KEY=base64:$(openssl rand -base64 32)" >> .env echo "JWT_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 32)" >> .env docker compose up -d ``` > [!TIP] > **Windows 用户**：密钥生成方法请参阅 `./docker/all-in-one/README.md`。 打开 `http://localhost:8123` 并创建您的账户。 📖 [完整安装指南](https://hi.events/docs/getting-started?utm_source=gh-readme) > [!IMPORTANT] > **从 1.x 升级？** 升级前请先阅读[发布说明](https://github.com/HiEventsDev/hi.events/releases)。 ### REST API 在 **设置 → API 密钥** 中创建 API 密钥，API 参考文档也在那里。
## 语言 English、Deutsch、Français、Italiano、Nederlands、Español、Português、Português (Brasil)、 Polski、Čeština、Slovenčina、Magyar、Svenska、Suomi、Ελληνικά、Türkçe、Tiếng Việt、简体中文、繁體中文、日本語和한국어。 欢迎提交翻译修正或新增语言——请参阅[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)。
## Hi.Events Cloud 不想自行托管？**[Hi.Events Cloud](https://app.hi.events/auth/register?utm_source=gh-readme)** 是全托管 版本，由 Hi.Events 的开发团队亲自运营。 [立即开始 →](https://app.hi.events/auth/register?utm_source=gh-readme)
## 许可 Hi.Events 采用 **AGPL-3.0 及附加条款** 授权。附加条款要求在本软件生成的页面和邮件中保留 "Powered by Hi.Events" 署名——具体措辞请参阅 [LICENCE](LICENCE)。 座位预订和票房功能受 [Hi.Events Enterprise Licence](backend/ee/LICENCE) 约束，用于生产环境 需要获得许可。 **我们提供商业许可**，适用于希望移除署名或需要白标 部署条款的用户。[许可方案](https://hi.events/licensing?utm_source=gh-readme) · [hello@hi.events](mailto:hello@hi.events)

## 安全 发现安全漏洞？请通过 [security@hi.events](mailto:security@hi.events) 私下报告，不要公开 提交 issue。详见我们的[安全政策](SECURITY.md)。
